It is also the correct outcome for a licensing or disclosure violation, which the storefront can see and telemetry structurally cannot: an unregistered pharmacy has the same payment shape as a registered one.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100072 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 444 days ago. Telemetry agrees: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are chargeback_rate at +7.2 sigma (observed 0.0139 against a category baseline of 0.0021), slope_log_volume at +6.1 sigma (observed 0.0158 against a category baseline of 0.00176), chargeback_drift at +3.0 sigma (observed 0.00777 against a category baseline of 0). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.99 confidence, against a declared category of home_furnishing. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. In total 1 independent view of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier is a merchant verification call. Settlements continue: one dissenting view is enough to ask, not to hold. A model is 0.99 confident, but only 1 independent view dissents -- model confidence is not evidence agreement, and the action reflects the latter.
